title: TOKN across disciplines
prompt: Create a premium public-facing executive infographic for TOKN. Native large landscape 4K canvas, 3840 by 2160. Light theme only: warm white background, deep navy typography, pale teal blue amber lavender panels. Editorial annual-report quality, meticulously aligned, restrained field illustrations, abundant whitespace, sharp typography, sophisticated not cartoonish. No software architecture, source code, APIs or small implementation labels. Design for a GitHub README: short large labels readable when scaled down, generous 140px edge margins, no text clipping. Main headline exactly: ONE HARNESS. MANY DISCIPLINES. Subheading exactly: Start in Community. Explore specialized domains. A visually strong central TOKN text mark connects six spacious domain-family cards, three on each side. Center supporting phrase: Your models. Your tools. Your rules. Six cards with these exact labels and examples: 1 Life sciences & care / Genomics / Drug discovery / Clinical research; 2 Engineering & mobility / Robotics / Semiconductors / Space & marine; 3 Energy & infrastructure / Power grids / Green energy / Oil & gas; 4 Earth & environment / Climate / Air quality / Earth observation; 5 Business & assurance / Financial risk / Legal analysis / App security; 6 Matter & computation / Materials / Structural biology / Quantum science. Give each card a tasteful field-specific illustration, not icon clutter. The cards show illustrative groupings, NOT six products and NOT six license tiers. A clear bottom access strip with two distinct labeled areas. Left exact wording: COMMUNITY / Core tools and learning / Three fixed previews: battery, maps, power grid. The only icons inside this Community strip must be a BATTERY, a MAP and a POWER PYLON; never DNA or a medical icon because Community does not preview those domains. Right exact wording: FULL DOMAIN WORKFLOWS / Licensed access. Safeguards retained. Small but readable footer: Illustrative groupings. Decision support, not certification. Never imply that all these domains are unlocked in Community, that buying a license disables safeguards, or that TOKN guarantees compliance. No padlock imagery implying a crippled free tier. Visual breadth should feel inspiring, grounded and immediately understandable to a nontechnical executive. Do not add unrequested text, statistics, invented capabilities, partner logos or a number of domains. Preserve the exact word fixed in the Community preview label.

title: TOKN capability with control
prompt: Create the companion executive infographic to TOKN across disciplines. Native landscape 4K canvas 3840 by 2160, warm white/light theme, deep navy typography with restrained pale teal blue amber lavender accents. Premium editorial infographic, meticulously crafted coherent grid, lots of whitespace, crisp vector-style illustrations, no code or technical architecture. All wording large and concise for a GitHub README; preserve generous margins, no tiny legal paragraph, no crowded arrows. Main headline exactly: CAPABILITY WITH CONTROL. Subtitle exactly: A clear path from intent to a reviewable result. Main horizontal visual journey of five elegantly connected stages: DESCRIBE / Set the goal; EQUIP / Choose capabilities; WORK / Use your model and tools; CHECK / Inspect evidence and findings; REVIEW / Decide the next step. Under the journey, a spacious four-part capability toolkit with plain-language exact labels: TOOLS / Take actions; SKILLS / Guide the approach; PLUGINS / Package reusable capabilities; HOOKS / Respond at key moments. Make these four distinct and visually coherent, not four competing products. Include a clearly bounded, smaller real-world example card on the right or bottom: FIXED COMMUNITY PREVIEW / A battery passport contradicts itself / A check finds the mismatch / A person reviews what follows. Use a simple passport/document illustration with two mismatched colored chemistry labels and one amber finding marker, not formulas. A bottom human-control ribbon with three clear short commitments: Choose your provider / Approve external data sharing / Keep safety gates in force. Final concise footnote: Typed judgments advise. Code controls action. This is a capability explanation, not proof of a particular completed live run. Do not claim guarantees, certification, automatic approval, universal safety, or that all domain tools are free. Do not depict a passing check as production authorization. Keep it executive-facing and inviting, with visual depth that explains how TOKN combines useful capabilities with retained human responsibility. No unrequested prose or invented metrics.
